description.text: "This program is to cultivate students to master basic theory and knowledge of tourism management subjects, know the development in tourism, aquire the ability of analyzing and settling problems by utilizing tourism management theory and be qualified for careers in tourism administration departments at all leves, tourism enterprizes and tourism institutions. Major Courses: Management, Micro-economics, Macro-economics, Accounting, Management Information System, Statistics, Financial Management, Marketing Management, Economic Law, Brief Introduction of Tourism, Tourism Economics, Hotel Management Principle, Tourism Resources and Their Development, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor’s Degree in Management"

duration.text: The Tourism Management at Henan University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above

requirements.text: The applicant should be a graduate of senior high school and should hold an HSK certificate of level 6 or above.
